subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the stale guard assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should these official action revisions be approved for the token-bearing, release, CodeQL, and Codex agent workflows?
rationale: The pull request has a protected security label and changes executable third-party code with access to secrets, publishing, scanning, and agent execution; final trust acceptance belongs to the workflow/security owner.

options.title: Approve After Repair
options.body: Accept the verified official releases once the focused workflow tests pass on the exact head.

options.title: Split Sensitive Actions
options.body: Separate token, publishing, CodeQL, and Codex action updates into narrower pull requests for independent trust review.

options.title: Hold Existing Pins
options.body: Keep the current revisions pending additional release-specific validation.

recommendation.title: Approve After Repair
recommendation.body: Accept the verified official releases once the focused workflow tests pass on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the coupled assertions and is the strongest identified owner for the repository workflow decision surface.
